2607.14658.title: TopoAgent: A Self-Evolving Topological Agent for Multimodal Scientific Reasoning
2607.14658.paper_summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general tasks, rigorous scientific reasoning remains challenging due to the limitations of monolithic, linear planning. Such sequential designs often suffer from visual-semantic misalignment, long-context hallucinations, and brittle execution under fixed task granularity. We propose TopoAgent, a self-evolving topological framework that replaces linear trajectories with dynamic, state-isolated graph evolution. TopoAgent first employs a front-end decomposer to fracture complex queries into visually-grounded atoms. These atoms are organized into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) based on their dependencies, enabling strict context isolation to shield the reasoning engine from irrelevant historical noise. Furthermore, we introduce adaptive atomic fission, which dynamically splits bottleneck nodes into finer-grained sub-atoms at runtime when tool capability boundaries are exceeded. Extensive experiments across mathematics, physics, and chemistry benchmarks demonstrate that TopoAgent significantly outperforms state-of-the-art linear agent frameworks, providing a robust, noise-resistant, and self-correcting paradigm for autonomous scientific reasoning.
2607.14658.paper_summary_zh: 雖然多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在一般任務中表現出色，但由於單一、線性規劃的限制，嚴謹的科學推理仍然具有挑戰性。這種順序設計往往受到視覺-語義不對齊、長上下文幻覺和在固定任務粒度下脆弱執行的影響。我們提出了TopoAgent，一個自我演化的拓撲框架，將線性軌跡替換為動態、狀態隔離的圖形演變。TopoAgent首先使用前端分解器將複雜查詢分解為視覺基礎的原子。這些原子根據其依賴關係組織成一個有向無環圖（DAG），實現嚴格的上下文隔離，以保護推理引擎免受無關歷史噪聲的干擾。此外，我們引入了自適應原子裂變，當工具能力邊界被超越時，動態地將瓶頸節點分裂為更細粒度的子原子。廣泛的數學、物理和化學基準實驗表明，TopoAgent顯著超越了最先進的線性代理框架，提供了一種穩健、抗噪聲和自我修正的自主科學推理範式。
